name: School Wars ~Sotsugyou Sensen~
original_name: スクール・ウォーズ～卒業戦線～
source:
The story takes place after Shiori graduates and now she has a month before she starts college. Unfortunately the school gets slammed with an investigation and instead of spending her spring break having fun, she has to spend her spring break making sure nothing weird happens so that their school isn’t shut down.  Also to add salt to the wound, aside from Itsuki and Shinya, all the relationship statuses with the rest have been reset.

[from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2013/09/03/otome-game-review-school-wars-sotsugyou-sensen/]Hinano's post[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在诗织毕业后、距离她开始大学生活还有一个月的时候。不幸的是，学校遭到调查，她无法愉快地度过春假，反而必须确保不发生任何异常，以免学校被关闭。雪上加霜的是，除了树和真也之外，她与其他人的关系状态全都被重置了。

[来自[url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2013/09/03/otome-game-review-school-wars-sotsugyou-sensen/]Hinano的博文[/url]]
